PopulationExplorer

Overview

PopulationExplorer is an R package developed for ETC5523: Communicating with Data at Monash University.

It provides an interactive Shiny application for exploring Australian state and territory population changes between 2010 and 2025.

The application is intended for students and members of the public interested in Australian population trends.

Research question: How have Australian state and territory populations changed between 2010 and 2025, and which areas experienced faster growth?

Features

The Shiny application allows users to:

  • Select an Australian state or territory.
  • Choose a starting and ending year.
  • Explore annual population trends using an interactive selection and line chart.
  • Calculate absolute and percentage population growth.
  • View a table of annual population estimates.
  • Read automatically generated interpretations of population changes.

The application also provides explanatory information, data limitations and helpful messages for invalid year selections.

Data

The package includes population_tidy, a dataset containing 128 observations for Australia’s eight states and territories.

The dataset contains three variables:

  • year: Calendar year, 2010–2025.
  • state: State or territory abbreviation.
  • population: Estimated resident population in persons.

The original data were obtained from the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS), National, state and territory population, Table 4: Estimated Resident Population, States and Territories.

Source: https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/population/national-state-and-territory-population

The data were prepared by selecting June population estimates for 2010–2025, retaining the eight states and territories and converting the spreadsheet into tidy format.

The preparation script and original spreadsheet are included in the data-raw directory for reproducibility.

ABS data are reused with attribution under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence, subject to the ABS’s stated exclusions.

Licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Installation

Install the package from GitHub using:

install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github(
  "ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-rikhithavarma"
)

Launch the Shiny app

After installation:

library(PopulationExplorer)

run_population_app()

The app opens in an RStudio Viewer or web browser.

Population growth function

The package also provides an exported function for calculating population changes between two selected years.

library(PopulationExplorer)

data("population_tidy", package = "PopulationExplorer")

summarise_population(
  population_tidy,
  start_year = 2010,
  end_year = 2025
)

The function returns the starting population, ending population, absolute population change and percentage growth for each state or territory.

Interpreting the results

Population change is the difference between population estimates at the beginning and the end.

Percentage growth measures this difference relative to the starting population. It represents total growth over the selected period rather than an annual growth rate.

The data are estimated resident populations, not exact counts. The application does not determine the causes of changes in populations such as migration, births or deaths.
